title: Spacecraft command authentication mandatory
body: All telecommands shall require authenticated envelope (HMAC or signed). Unauthenticated commands shall be silently dropped on the spacecraft side. Replay window N=4096 nonces, monotonic counter per issuer enforced.
citation: CCSDS 350.7 Security Architecture for Space Data Systems §4

title: Post-Quantum migration plan
body: Spacecraft cryptographic stacks shall plan PQC migration before 2030. Hybrid mode (X25519 + ML-KEM) acceptable for transition period. RSA-2048 key-exchange forbidden in new designs after 2027.
citation: NIST SP 800-227 (draft) PQC Migration Guidance; CCSDS Recommendation 352.0

title: Boot integrity attestation
body: Every boot of safety-critical FPGA/processor shall measure boot chain components against expected SHA-256 hashes. Mismatch triggers safe-mode entry; ground recovery required to clear.
citation: NIST SP 800-193 Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines

title: Suspected uplink spoofing
body: If multiple uplink commands arrive with valid signatures but conflicting state assertions, declare suspected key-compromise. Rotate uplink session key via emergency-key-derivation procedure (ground-only); invalidate prior session counters.
